text.p: Here are the highlights from Swiss newspapers on Tuesday:

- Free trade between Switzerland, EU and EFTA partners will expand at the beginning of 1997 to include Bulgaria, Slovakia, the Czech Republic, Slovenia and Rumania. Other Eastern European states will be added in March and July. - Swiss automobile sales fell in 1996 to below 270,000 compared to 271,000 in 1995.
- Some 100 companies in Switzerland will be required to declare their use of certain types of chemicals starting January 1, as a measure to prevent the manufacture of chemical weapons.
- American Airlines will no longer fly the Zurich - New York route as of the end of January due to high costs.
- Hotelplan Group's sales rose by 9.8 percent to 593 million Swiss francs in the 1995/96 fiscal year.
- Some 100 farmers from western Switzerland protested France's import ban on Swiss beef by preventing the delivery of cheese and milk from France to a dairy processing plant near Geneva.
